name: SDK tools for RISC-V machine code programming

mentions.name: SDK tools for RISC-V machine code programming
mentions.description: A methodology and set of SDK tools for writing RISC-V machine code programs more comfortably, outputting a very simple custom file format that uses only the core ISA (no compressed instructions, no pseudo instructions) with just a simple C preprocessor.
mentions.source_excerpt: In the end, I did design some kind of methodology and coded some SDK tools in order to write a bit more comfortably RISC-V machine code programs in a very simple fire format (only core ISA, not even compressed instructions, no pseudo instructions, using only a simple C preprocessor).

evidence.value: In the end, I did design some kind of methodology and coded some SDK tools in order to write a bit more comfortably RISC-V machine code programs in a very simple fire format (only core ISA, not even compressed instructions, no pseudo instructions, using only a simple C preprocessor).
